newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian treasury raises 4 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian treasury raises 4 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday raised four million dinars at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated Aug 5, and repaid maturing paper totalling 13.5 million dinars.
It sold two-year notes payable in equal annual tranches worth four million dinars at a 6.9375 percent coupon rate, down from 7.0000 percent at last week's auction.
Banks bid for 271 million dinars for 52-week and two-year paper at between 6.8750 and 7.2500 percent. ($1 = 1.1612 dinar)
